t: This is the Prince Consort's Lodge, a Grade II star listed building standing in Kennington Park. It was designed by Henry Roberts, a British architect best known for Fishmongers' Hall in London and for his work on model dwellings for workers. That interest in housing for ordinary people is worth keeping in mind as you look at it. The building was made by William Higgs, an English building contractor. So you have two men here, one who drew it and one who built it, and the lodge is the result of their work together.
